title: MOLTEN GLASS VS Prince Rupert's Drop - Smarter Every Day 285
summary: Destin Sandlin of Smarter Every Day explores molten glass and Prince Rupert's drops with a glass artist, including a process that freezes the moment glass shatters and an artisan who makes the drops.
why: Commenters recommend it for the striking glass-shattering visuals and the artist's attitude of treating failure as a space for discovery.

quote.text: Learn about and see how it’s made
